user.title: Add tariff
user.description: Prices in {currency} per kWh. A price of 0 is allowed, e.g. for free charging at work or with your own solar power.

data_description.price_ac: Leave empty if the provider offers no AC charging.
data_description.price_dc: Leave empty if the provider offers no DC charging. At least one price is required.
data_description.zones: Optional. When a charge ends in one of these zones, this tariff is preselected. A zone can belong to only one tariff.
data_description.monthly_fee: Optional. Booked automatically for every started month and added to the vehicle's total cost and average price.
data_description.fee_vehicle_id: Required with a monthly fee: the vehicle that carries the fee.
data_description.fee_start: Required with a monthly fee: first month (any day of the month).
data_description.fee_end: Optional, e.g. after cancelling: last month that is charged.

menu_options.edit: Correct name, zones and current prices

add_price.title: New prices for {tariff}
add_price.description: Prices in {currency} per kWh. They apply to sessions from this date on; booked sessions keep their stored cost.

data_description.monthly_fee: Optional. Applies to months starting on or after this date. Empty: the previous monthly fee stays.
data_description.price_ac: Leave empty if the provider offers no AC charging from this date on.
data_description.price_dc: Leave empty if the provider offers no DC charging from this date on. At least one price is required.

delete_price.title: Delete a price version of {tariff}
delete_price.description: Booked sessions keep their stored cost. The prices from the beginning cannot be deleted.

reference.title: Reference prices for {tariff}
reference.description: Prices in {currency} per kWh you would pay without this subscription (e.g. the ad hoc price). The page "Charging log" uses them for the savings of the subscription minus its monthly fee. Booked sessions do not change.

data_description.reference_price_ac: Optional. Empty: AC sessions count without savings. For new prices from a date: empty keeps the previous reference price.
data_description.reference_price_dc: Optional. Empty: DC sessions count without savings. For new prices from a date: empty keeps the previous reference price.

edit.title: Edit tariff
edit.description: Prices in {currency} per kWh, valid today. Use this to correct typos; for a price change use "New prices from a date". Booked sessions keep their stored cost.

data_description.fee_vehicle_id: Required with a monthly fee: the vehicle that carries the fee.

add_session.name: Add session
add_session.description: Books a charging session. The cost is calculated from the tariff now and stored; a given cost overrides the tariff.

energy_kwh.name: Energy
energy_kwh.description: Charged energy from the receipt or the provider's app.

charge_type.name: Charge type
charge_type.description: AC or DC; selects the tariff price.

tariff.name: Tariff
tariff.description: Tariff used. Required unless a cost is given.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Total amount. Overrides the tariff calculation; 0 is allowed.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: End of charging. Defaults to now.

soc_start.name: SoC start
soc_start.description: Display only, never used for costs.

soc_end.name: SoC end
soc_end.description: Display only, never used for costs.

update_session.name: Update session
update_session.description: Corrects a session, by default the vehicle's last one. Changing only the energy keeps the stored price; changing tariff or charge type uses the tariff's current price.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Session to change. Defaults to the vehicle's last session.

clear_cost.name: Clear cost
clear_cost.description: Remove a manual cost and calculate from the tariff again.

clear_soc_start.name: Clear SoC start
clear_soc_start.description: Remove the start SoC of the session.

clear_soc_end.name: Clear SoC end
clear_soc_end.description: Remove the end SoC of the session.

delete_session.name: Delete session
delete_session.description: Deletes a session, by default the vehicle's last one.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Session to delete. Defaults to the vehicle's last session.

list_sessions.name: List sessions
list_sessions.description: Returns sessions as response data, sorted by time.

start.name: From
start.description: Only sessions at or after this time.

end.name: Until
end.description: Only sessions at or before this time.

set_odometer_start.name: Set odometer start
set_odometer_start.description: Sets the start point of the cost per 100 km: the odometer reading on a day from which on all paid sessions are recorded. Use it if you entered older sessions afterwards.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading on that day, in the length unit of Home Assistant (km or mi).

since.name: From
since.description: Sessions from this day on count, e.g. the day of delivery or of the first recorded session.
